title: [AI] Fix phantom overspending after deleting a category
issueTitle: [Bug]: Deleting Certain Categories Creates Irreconcilable Phantom Overspend
why: The report gives a full from-scratch repro using one account, two categories, a deposit, a budget transfer and a category delete. In the next month the fixed app should show no overspend, while the buggy app shows a phantom 10.00 overspent.
